requiredDispositionRevisions.reason: Both stored witnesses merely contain the generic caste/lineage designation in copied patriarchal biography. No master deploys the word as an answer, verdict, test, case handle, or other observable Chan job. Distinct files do not turn contained-only biography into deployment.

The claim that the corpus retains 佛 and has no independent shorter referent is false. Masters independently say 大通智勝遷座而成正覺, ask 喚作大通智勝得麼, and command 參大通智勝去; other witnesses use 大通智勝如來. The name is productively deployed without 佛.

This is a complete proposition, not merely a damaged tail. Independent deployed forms include 智者知心是佛, 心心心是佛, 是心是佛, 自心是佛, and 心即是佛. The shorter headword is the stable searchable core across operators, precisely where synonym/form coverage is needed.

The string is not uniformly a truncation of 摩訶迦葉. 指月錄 explicitly names 拘那含佛弟子摩訶迦尊者 and attributes three vows to him; other passages use 摩訶迦 as a prefix of 迦葉, 迦羅, or mantra strings. Count complete-name witnesses separately, identify the invoked figure, and keep or reject that sense on its own evidence.

The stored cases show the 無佛處 formula, but the corpus also deploys 急走過 independently as a capping imperative, including 急走過，莫放過 in a case verse. Review those independent uses before deciding; the current blanket suffix ruling is not supported.

requiredEvidenceAndProseRepairs.finding: The two stored witnesses are duplicate transmissions of the same 三世佛冤 case and do not anchor the claim ‘productive beyond the longer saying.’
requiredEvidenceAndProseRepairs.repair: Anchor genuinely independent deployment, e.g. 宏智禪師廣錄's 三世諸佛/三世佛 fire-flame exchange and 雪巖祖欽禪師語錄's 三世佛望風斂影, then restate the collective designation from those cases.

diversificationYieldReview.finding: Diversification materially recovered from batch6's 4/25 local yield and produced genuine geography, cosmology, case-locus, epithet, implement, and interview-action candidates instead of mostly narrator tails.
diversificationYieldReview.qualification: The final yield must be recomputed after the five disposition repairs. At minimum, the two clear false rejects and one clear false keep move the settled KEEP count from 13 to 14; 摩訶迦 and 急走過 require bounded re-adjudication. The diversification conclusion remains positive.
